newsitem.title: USA: TABLE- Air Canada Q2 shr C$0.44 vs C$0.69.
newsitem.headline: TABLE- Air Canada Q2 shr C$0.44 vs C$0.69.

text.p: (All data above millions except per share numbers)

NOTE: Operating income for the six month period was $68 million versus a loss of $3 million in 1996. The 1997 results include a pre-tax gain of $171 million, compared to $129 million in 1996, on the sale of Continental shares and an estimated $57 million adverse operating income impact caused by a labour disruption at four Regional Airlines during the first quarter of this year.

Removing the effect of these items, operating income for the six months improved by $128 million with non-operating expense declining $61 million for a $189 million improvement in pre-tax income. Income tax provision, net of recoveries of prior years' income taxes, was $48 million versus $8 million in 1996.
